# End-of-life note

## System

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| AI system or model | ticket-ranker v1.4.0 |
| Planned retirement date | 2028-06-30 |
| Owner | Platform team |

## Model retirement or transfer

The model is archived in the internal registry and handed over to the platform archive team. No other copy stays on laptops or in test accounts.

## Data and configuration deletion

| Item | Action | Done on |
|---|---|---|
| training dataset snapshot | deleted from the registry and backups | on retirement |
| service credentials and keys | revoked and removed | on retirement |
| prompt and request logs | purged after 90 days | on retirement |

## Who is told

Service desk users and the customer data controllers are informed by email 60 days before retirement, and the support teams by the change notice.
